Approval closes the four original SOURCE mechanisms only. It is not live H03 acceptance, stock-supervisor recovery certification or global phase closure.

finding_dispositions.producer_caller_finalizer: The caller checkpoints nonce, exact name, CID-file path, roots and daemon before create. Create's finally always runs recover_cid, even when docker refuses stderr or communicate cancels. Recovery opens a non-following private file and requires regular type, exact 0600, current UID, single link and canonical lowercase 64-hex CID, or resolves the registered exact name. inspect_owned then binds CID/image/name/owner nonce before any stop/rm. Finalizer can retry locator recovery when cid is empty and attempts exact owned cleanup independently of the original create return.
finding_dispositions.adjudication: The original lost-CID/cleanup-skipped mechanisms no longer reproduce. Warning/cancellation retain locators and cleanup the attested stopped resource through the seam. Missing or delayed daemon ACK is not claimed settled: original unknown remains latched and the DB remains fenced.
finding_dispositions.limit: CID-file filesystem controls use real private files; daemon creation/cancellation is substituted, not a physical Docker cancellation. A late unknown create is contained by retained nonce/name/daemon/CID locators and permanent uncertainty, not certified absent.

finding_dispositions.producer_caller_finalizer: retire_host first attests current resource ownership/state. Host connect/drain is conditional on Running=true; a stopped/unstarted resource does not require RPC. Running graceful errors latch cleanup_failed but still reach bounded Docker stop. The outer finalizer independently re-attests and attempts stop/rm/absence even when retire_host refuses, then attempts runtime, public-owner and engine cleanup.
finding_dispositions.adjudication: Known created-but-unstarted cleanup now reaches exact removal without connect. A graceful drain failure no longer abandons resource or later-owner cleanup. Failed readbacks still refuse settlement and retain the DB rather than emitting a clean result.
finding_dispositions.limit: Host and daemon seams are substituted. This verifies SOURCE cleanup ordering and ownership predicates, not a physical stock Host failure/reap.

finding_dispositions.producer_caller_finalizer: The caller reads daemon ID and exact immutable image configuration before create. Dependent Docker operations compare daemon ID before and after. The actual container oracle checks image/name/nonce, stock ordered Cmd/entrypoint/user, exact image Env and no declared Volumes; read-only/no-network/private PID and relevant namespaces; privilege/caps/security; typed PID/memory/CPU limits, tmpfs, device/port/volumes-from refusal; exactly two complete bind mount entries with exact physical roots/destinations, RW/type/mode/propagation. h03_container_argv requires physically canonical non-symlink same-UID 0700 scratch directories. Full oracle runs both after create and before start.
finding_dispositions.adjudication: The original undeclared mount/namespace/privilege/environment/physical-alias false greens are closed at the actual pre-start consumer. The exact-two-mount inventory denies both original Docker-socket and personal-profile extra mounts; no personal content was read. Actual daemon readback supplies its benign SecurityOpt spelling and nullable Devices variant, and the same SOURCE positive accepts them while the corresponding containment negatives still refuse.
finding_dispositions.limit: Read-only existing Docker samples establish field compatibility, not an exact H03 created-container positive. No new container was created. Actual H03 tmpfs/resource-limit serialization and complete live pre-start positive remain part of the parent's real QA, not certified by a fixture projection.

finding_dispositions.producer_caller_finalizer: Docker mutations set docker_unknown and the dynamic DB fence before child admission, restoring only the prior latch after recognized exact ACK plus unchanged daemon identity. Exceptions retain unknown; successful later stop/rm/absence cannot clear an earlier unknown. Reader admission likewise fences first and uses historical_run_gate, whose existing owner validates exact receipt keys/types, child code and family_drained=true. The H03 caller additionally requires the exact installed ORIGIN/READY/EXIT tuple and normal exit 0 or 2. Finalizer drains task/heartbeat ownership, retires/rechecks resources, closes runtime/public owner and disposes the engine before releasing the DB fence; any failure or prior unknown refuses release.
finding_dispositions.adjudication: The original false settlement after cancelled stop and premature fence release before public-owner cleanup no longer reproduce. Recognized installed denial can settle its managed family without becoming product success. Timeout/cancellation/unknown exit/bad audit remain uncertain; retry/absence do not forgive the original Docker request. The existing destructive DB-fixture guard observes the same retained fence.
finding_dispositions.limit: Reader family/installed/DB seams are substituted in the six new producer controls. The strict existing family owner is traced, not freshly physically requalified. No native/PostgreSQL/OCI launch occurred; unchanged H01 ownership evidence is reused within its original scope.
